newsitem.title: USA: Tracor to buy ADR Associates.
newsitem.headline: Tracor to buy ADR Associates.

text.p: Tracor Inc unit GDE Systems Inc said it agreed to buy 100 percent of the stock of privately held ADR Associates Inc., of Pennsauken, N.J.

ADR Associates, which reported 1995 revenues of $10.3 million, uses photogrammetric technology to produce digital mapping and geographic information systems (GIS) database services, primarily for federal, county, and municipal governments in the United States.
ADR has the nation's largest photogrammetric compilation capacity in private industry and has been operating for 26 years, Tracor said.
